## Proprietary IIPL SaaS & AI Platforms

### 1. IIPL Lead
- **URL**: https://lead.itobyinfotech.com
- **Category**: AI B2B Lead Automation & Sales CRM
- **Description**: IIPL Lead extracts localized business leads from Google Maps, runs 15-second AI website health audits, generates personalized client pitch decks, and executes multi-sender cold email campaigns with automated DNS inbox warmup.

### 2. IIPL Renting
- **URL**: https://rent.itobyinfotech.com
- **Category**: Commercial Property Leasing & Tenant Management SaaS
- **Description**: IIPL Renting automates office leasing operations, tenant KYC onboarding, lease agreement generation, recurring maintenance deposits, and automated WhatsApp rent payment reminders.

### 3. IIPL Billing
- **URL**: https://billing.itobyinfotech.com
- **Category**: Enterprise GST Invoicing & Revenue Software
- **Description**: Tax-compliant GST billing software providing automated client ledgers, E-Way bill API sync, recurring client retainer billing, and integrated online payment gateways.

### 4. IIPL Cashmemo
- **URL**: https://cashmemo.itobyinfotech.com
- **Category**: Digital Cash Receipt & POS Generator
- **Description**: Fast POS cash receipt generator for retail counters and service providers. Enables 5-second cash memo creation, WhatsApp PDF delivery, and thermal receipt printing.

### 5. IIPL Calling
- **URL**: https://royalblue-ant-234341.hostingersite.com/
- **Category**: Autonomous Conversational AI Voice Agents
- **Description**: Sub-500ms conversational AI voice agents capable of handling 24/7 restaurant table reservations, insurance policy renewal calls, and sales lead qualification.
